name: Momiji wa Akaku Sono Mi o Somete
original_name: モミジは紅く其の身を染めて
source:
Momiji tells the story of Masaki, a seemingly normal high-schooler in every way. Spending his time with his 2 friends Hiroaki and Shuuya and the girl he is interested in Yuri.
But he also has a terrible secret, 5 years before he caused by accident the death of his childhood friend and crush, Kaede. In pure shock in front of the dead body he could do nothing but recite an incantation written in a strange book he found by chance, a spell that could seemingly resuscitate the death.
Waking up from passing out the body of Kaede disappeared without a trace, the next day her family too vanished. With only the vivid memory of her death in mind, Masaki didn't felt sadness or guilt over losing his friend but rather fear at being caught as a murderer.

And 5 years later while people start to disappear again, Kaede reappears in front of Masaki looking exactly the same as 5 years ago, is she the illusion of his deranged mind, or…

[From [url=https://hadlerblog.wordpress.com/2017/02/14/モミジは紅く其の身を染めて-and-dear-my-abyss-reviews/]hadlerblog[/url]]
translation:
《红叶》讲述了真树的故事——一个看似各方面都很普通的高中生。他和两个朋友宏明、修也以及他感兴趣的女孩子百合一起度过时光。但他也有一个可怕的秘密：五年前，他意外地导致了青梅竹马兼暗恋对象枫的死亡。在尸体面前，他完全惊呆了，只能念诵一本偶然发现的奇怪书上的咒语——一个似乎能复活死者的法术。从昏迷中醒来后，枫的尸体已消失得无影无踪，第二天她的家人也不见了。脑海中只剩下她死亡的鲜明记忆，真树对失去朋友并不感到悲伤或内疚，而是害怕被当作杀人犯抓起来。

五年后，当人们再次开始消失时，枫出现在真树面前，看起来和五年前一模一样。她是他精神错乱的幻觉，还是……
